name: Forrás entitás
definition: Stable household or source entity key

name: Régiós séma
notes: Mixed schemes fail closed; not a DSO claim.

name: Evidence status
notes: Mixed or Q evidence propagates Q.

name: Battery töltési teljesítmény
notes: Diagnostic only; not an independent battery authority.

name: Battery kisütési teljesítmény
notes: Diagnostic only; not an independent battery authority.

name: SOC hányad
notes: Never summed as energy or power.

name: B07 handoff státusz
notes: Caller cannot replace upstream truth status.

name: Forrás natív sorozatazonosító
definition: Stable source series identifier for an observed load panel
notes: Required for duplicate detection and revision lineage.

name: Normalizált intervallumkezdet
definition: Timezone-aware interval start normalized to UTC
notes: Source offset is preserved in provenance; no naive timestamps.

name: Normalizált intervallumvége
definition: Timezone-aware interval end normalized to UTC
notes: Interval end equals start plus explicit source resolution.

name: Forrás natív felbontás
definition: ENTSO-E source-native market time unit resolution
notes: Only PT15M/PT30M/PT60M accepted; no implicit hourly conversion.

name: Observed total load power
notes: OBS only for A65/A16/A04 source rows; missing remains Q.

name: Observed interval duration
notes: Derived from accepted resolution and never assumed to be one hour.

name: Derived interval energy
definition: Observed-load power multiplied by explicit interval duration
notes: Explicit DER transformation only; no silent resampling.

name: Observed spatial grain
notes: No county or DSO relabelling; Q-B01-002 remains open.

name: Acquisition provenance
definition: Publisher URL retrieval revision licence and checksum metadata
notes: Raw external only until primary-owner reuse status and an acquired response checksum are recorded.
